     <title>captrader(.)group: Bafin warns about website and identity theft</title>
     <link>https://www.bafin.de/SharedDocs/Veroeffentlichungen/EN/Verbrauchermitteilung/unerlaubte/2026/meldung_2026_10_21_captrader_group_en.html</link>
     <pubDate>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:37:00 +0200</pubDate>
     <description>The German Financial Supervisory Authority (Bafin) warns about offers on the website captrader(.)group. It is suspected that the unknown operators are offering financial services on the website without the required authorisation. Contrary to the website operators&#8217; claims, the website is not operated by CapTrader GmbH, who has no connection whatsoever to the website and the offered services. This is a case of identity theft.&#160;</description>

     <description>The Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (Bafin) warns against offers on the websites vantex-bank(.)com and vantex-bank(.)net.
